snippet.title: Wreckreation | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wreckreation will release on October 28th, 2025 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. 

Wreckreation is the home of your very own open world, a 400 square kilometer racing realm that is yours to create, shape – and wreck. 
 
- Links & Info -  
Steam: https://thqn.net/w-steam 
Website: https://wreckreation.thqnordic.com 
Discord: https://discord.gg/wreckreation
